Summary: Heaven is God's dwelling place and the future home of the redeemed, where God's people will live in His presence, free from sin, sorrow, and death, in a renewed creation. Christian hope looks not to escape the world forever, but to resurrection life in the new heaven and new earth.
HistoricalDevelopment: Confessed in historic creeds in the hope of resurrection and life everlasting, heaven was explored by Augustine in The City of God and by Aquinas and later writers on the beatific vision and eternal life.
Interpretations: Christians agree on eternal life with God, while differing on the intermediate state between death and resurrection and on how literally to read biblical images of heaven and the new creation.
RelatedTopics: Resurrection; Eternal Life; Second Coming; Hope
RelatedPeople: Augustine; Aquinas; Jonathan Edwards; C. S. Lewis
